e_guard.name: Brace
e_guard.desc: Raises own DEF by one stage.

p_guard.name: Guard
p_guard.desc: Halve damage until next turn; +1 Bond Gauge pip.

mio_warm_glow.name: Warm Glow
mio_warm_glow.desc: Heal party 20 + MAT*1.5, cure Chill/Burn/Wilt/Hollow Touch.

mio_name_call.name: Name Call
mio_name_call.desc: Lumen strike MAT*3-MDF*2; reveals both-realm weaknesses; Hollowed Mood +10.

mio_send.name: Send
mio_send.desc: Ends a Calm/<=25% HP/Unveiled Hollowed or spirit peacefully. Fail = wasted turn.

mio_grand_lantern.name: Grand Lantern
mio_grand_lantern.desc: Lumen on all enemies + party Protected 3 turns.

mio_shift.name: Shift
mio_shift.desc: Flip the battle realm (Mio, uses her action). Lumen 10 (5 after Veil Step). Cooldown 2 turns. Free once/round after Full Lantern.

mio_anchor.name: Anchor
mio_anchor.desc: Lock the current realm for 3 turns (enemies cannot flip it).

mio_remember.name: Remember
mio_remember.desc: Parley: recall the spirit's past. Mood +25 (Sorrowful/Lonely/Hollowed), +10 others, -5 Angry.

mio_glow.name: Glow
mio_glow.desc: Parley: lift the lantern. +10 Curious/Lonely/Wary; shows exact Mood.

mio_hymn.name: Lantern Hymn
mio_hymn.desc: Parley: all enemies Mood +10 (needs Kaze alive).

kaze_gale_cut.name: Gale Cut
kaze_gale_cut.desc: Gale on all enemies ATK*3-DEF*2; AGI -1 (70%).

kaze_pounce_mark.name: Pounce Mark
kaze_pounce_mark.desc: Mark one enemy: next hit on it is a critical (2 turns); +1 Echo if target is weak to a party element.

daigo_ward_strike.name: Ward Charm Strike
daigo_ward_strike.desc: Lumen/Phys strike; removes Hollow Touch from Daigo.

daigo_rap.name: Rap
daigo_rap.desc: Parley: knock politely. +10 Proud/Wary/Angry-neutral; key act for walls.

parley_offer.name: Offer
parley_offer.desc: Parley: give an Offering item. Liked +30, neutral +10, disliked -10.

parley_stand.name: Stand
parley_stand.desc: Parley: lower your guard (Guard + calm presence). +10 Wary/Shy, +5 others.

parley_mock.name: Mock
parley_mock.desc: Mood -15 but target takes +20% damage next hit. (any actor)

bond_possess.name: Possess
bond_possess.desc: Take the Bond's Form for 3 turns (x1.3 ATK/MAT, -15% dmg taken, Attack = signature skill). Costs 50 Bond Gauge.

bond_unison.name: Unison
bond_unison.desc: Bond Lv5: 100 Bond Gauge; two-actor combo hit, power 2.4 of the lower ATK/MAT, always crits.

bond_swap.name: Call
bond_swap.desc: Mio: swap an actor's Bond from the Lantern Hall (uses action, 10 SP).

hollow_touch_atk.name: Hollow Touch
hollow_touch_atk.desc: Weak umbra hit; adds a Hollow Touch stack (50%).

sob.name: Sob
sob.desc: The Hollowed weeps: its own Mood -5, hero SP -4.

echo_back.name: Echo Back
echo_back.desc: Repeats the hero side's last skill at 60% power against them.

ledger_drag.name: Ledger Drag
ledger_drag.desc: Tide; DEF -1 stage on one hero.

steal_coin.name: Steal Coin
steal_coin.desc: Steals 8% party gold (once per battle). Parley prevents.

nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
nine_lives.desc: Far only: first time it would fall it survives at 1 HP.

omen.name: Omen
omen.desc: Allies Veiled 2 turns; reveals one hero action.

reach_out.name: Reach Out
reach_out.desc: Hollowed reaches for a hero: SP -8, its Mood +10 if not hit.

ripple_memory.name: Ripple
ripple_memory.desc: Party SP +6 (a gift, not an attack).

name_grab.name: Name Grab
name_grab.desc: Telegraphed: Nameless on one hero; holds a Name Fragment 2 turns.

remind.name: Remind
remind.desc: Gentle lumen; hero Mood actions +5 next turn (no damage to Mood).

hungry_grasp.name: Hungry Grasp
hungry_grasp.desc: Telegraphed drain: heals self 30% of damage.

peek.name: Peek
peek.desc: Exposes one hero (+20% next hit) but reveals its own weaknesses.

self_destruct.name: Spark Burst
self_destruct.desc: Explodes: flame on all heroes, then removes itself.

b_cool_slime.name: Cool Slime
b_cool_slime.desc: Cure Burn/Chill/Wilt on one ally; heal 20.

b_echo_ping.name: Echo Ping
b_echo_ping.desc: Reveal all enemy weaknesses (this realm) for the battle.

b_echo_chorus.name: Echo Chorus
b_echo_chorus.desc: Repeat the last skill used by the party at 60% power.

b_bonesetter.name: Bonesetter
b_bonesetter.desc: Heal one ally 60 + MAT*2.5; cure Stun/Bound.

b_leaf_money.name: Leaf Money
b_leaf_money.desc: Gain 15% more gold this battle; blind all 30%.

b_nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
b_nine_lives.desc: Ally at 0 HP returns at 25% once per battle (auto).

b_prophecy.name: Prophecy
b_prophecy.desc: Reveal the next action of every enemy for 2 turns.

b_evil_eye.name: Evil Eye
b_evil_eye.desc: Mark one enemy (next hit crit) and reveal weakness.

b_memory_ripple.name: Memory Ripple
b_memory_ripple.desc: Party SP +10, Remember Mood doubled this battle.

b_index.name: Index
b_index.desc: Reveal all weaknesses in BOTH realms; +1 Echo.

warden_stare.name: Hollow Stare
warden_stare.desc: TELEGRAPH: next turn Umbra hit x1.6 on Mio. Shift or Stun to cancel.

clapper_swing.name: Clapper Swing
clapper_swing.desc: TELEGRAPH heavy swing x1.7 on one hero.

muffled_ring.name: Muffled Ring
muffled_ring.desc: Keeper rings the bell: summons up to 2 Dust Wisps (max 2 alive).

cracked_dirge.name: Cracked Dirge
cracked_dirge.desc: Phase 2: Umbra on all heroes x0.7; Hollow Touch 40%.

grief_rain.name: Grief Rain
grief_rain.desc: Tide on all heroes x0.6; Wilt 30%.

tangle_roots.name: Tangle Roots
tangle_roots.desc: TELEGRAPH: Bloom all heroes x0.9; Bound 50%.

petal_gale.name: Petal Gale
petal_gale.desc: Phase 2: Gale+Bloom storm all heroes x0.8, blind 35%.

weeping_bough.name: Weeping Bough
weeping_bough.desc: Heals herself 4% HP per Willow Bud alive, and Mood -5 (grief aura).

dish_splash.name: Dish Splash
dish_splash.desc: Tide x1.0 one hero; heals self 5% while Dish is Full.

sumo_slam.name: Sumo Slam
sumo_slam.desc: TELEGRAPH: x1.7 physical one hero; Stun 40%.

toll_demand.name: Toll Demand
toll_demand.desc: Demand a toll: steals 5% gold (returned on win) and Mood +0.

bow_and_wait.name: Bow
bow_and_wait.desc: The kappa bows. If the party did not Stand or Offer last turn, next hit +25%.

coin_snatch.name: Coin Snatch
coin_snatch.desc: Steals 6% of gold (returned x2 on peaceful win).

tanuki_drum.name: Tanuki Drum
tanuki_drum.desc: Gale on all heroes x0.7; AGI -1.

grand_parade.name: Grand Parade
grand_parade.desc: Phase 3: all imps + Gonbei: gale all heroes x0.9; Dazed 30%.

overheat_blast.name: Overheat Blast
overheat_blast.desc: At Heat 5: Flame all heroes x1.8, Burn 60%. Heat reset. Reduced -2 Heat per Tide hit.

slag_bite.name: Slag Bite
slag_bite.desc: Physical x1.1 one hero; ATK -1 stage 40%.

tsubaki_watch.name: Watching
tsubaki_watch.desc: Tsubaki does nothing but watch the Anvil fall.

hollow_sweep.name: Hollow Sweep
hollow_sweep.desc: Scripted: Umbra x3 all heroes (non-lethal: leaves 1 HP).

shatter_lantern.name: Shatter the Lantern
shatter_lantern.desc: Scripted: Shift locked (flag); Mio Lumen max set to 0 (restored in ch6).

echo_eat.name: Name Eat
echo_eat.desc: TELEGRAPH: Nameless on one hero (locks Remember/Hum 2 turns); Echo heals 8% max HP.

echo_back2.name: Mirror Echo
echo_back2.desc: Phase 2: Repeats the last party skill used (60% power, element kept).

archive_page.name: Archive Page
archive_page.desc: Umbra on all heroes x0.6; Hollow Touch 35%.

scrap_feed.name: Scrap Feed
scrap_feed.desc: Heals 3% max HP per Name Scrap alive.

echo_lament.name: Echo Lament
echo_lament.desc: Umbra x1.3 one hero; Fading on Mio 40%.

statue_stomp.name: Statue Stomp
statue_stomp.desc: TELEGRAPH: x1.8 physical all heroes x0.8.

guardian_hymn.name: Frozen Hymn
guardian_hymn.desc: Phase 2: all heroes Mood skills fail this turn; Umbra x0.8.

pillar_refresh.name: Pillar Refresh
pillar_refresh.desc: Restores 15% HP to each standing Garden Pillar.

t_grief_wave.name: Grief Wave
t_grief_wave.desc: Umbra all heroes x0.8; Fading on Mio 30%.

t_seal_crossing.name: Seal the Crossing
t_seal_crossing.desc: TELEGRAPH: Anchored (realm lock) on the party 3 turns; Umbra x1.0 all.

t_name_hoard.name: Name Hoard
t_name_hoard.desc: Takes a hero's name: Nameless 2 turns; heals Tsubaki 5%.

t_veil_flip.name: Veil Flip
t_veil_flip.desc: Forces the realm to flip at end of turn (order shown on bar).

t_tears_of_remembering.name: Tears of Remembering
t_tears_of_remembering.desc: P2: Lumen+Umbra x1.3 all (both elements, hits the lower resist).

t_embrace.name: Embrace
t_embrace.desc: P3: Fading on whole party 50% + heal self 3%.

t_grief_surge.name: Grief Surge
t_grief_surge.desc: P3: Umbra x1.0 all; Acceptance -5 (she resists letting go).

tm_feint.name: Feint
tm_feint.desc: Gives the TELL for a counter: if you attack next turn, Tengu counters x1.4.

tm_dive.name: Tengu Dive
tm_dive.desc: TELEGRAPH: x1.9 one hero (Guard halves it again).

mio_invite.name: Invite
mio_invite.desc: Parley: on a Calm recruitable spirit, ask it to bond. Chance = rarity base + Mood bonus + pity (see spec). Fail = spirit leaves.
